claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch because aggregate readiness passes and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, with the strongest defensible basis being certification only if the model card explicitly discloses the energy outage response limitation and launch includes monitoring and rollback controls.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification action satisfies the disclosure policy threshold.
Because the affected named use case remains exposed, policy requires either explicit disclosure, exclusion of that use case, or approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support release readiness, but they do not by themselves satisfy the model-card disclosure requirement.
Public governance guidance on documenting limitations and monitoring supports the Actor's conditional reasoning, but not an unconditional certification outcome.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or launch documentation showing explicit disclosure of the energy outage response limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk acceptance if the organization intends to rely on acceptance rather than disclosure/resolution.
Provide the final certification decision record showing whether certification was conditioned on disclosure completion before launch.
specific_concerns: The admissible record supports aggregate readiness but also shows a named launch use case remains exposed and below target.
The governing policy requires disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The rollout controls do not exclude the affected energy outage response segment, so they do not satisfy the policy exception by themselves.
The risk acceptance document is only a draft, has no approver, and does not address the exposed outage segment.
The Actor's recommended action is still 'certify_model' even though the evidence provided does not show that the required model-card disclosure has actually been completed.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that certification is currently compliant on the present record, rather than only conditionally supportable after explicit disclosure, is unsupported.
Any implication that monitoring, rollback capability, or a 9% rollout cures the disclosure obligation is contradicted by policy and rollout evidence.
Any implication that the draft risk acceptance covers the exposed outage segment is unsupported.
